name: Bond of Flora (Floral)
body:
Your awakening bond with nature graces you with the ability to sense and commune with plant life.

Prerequisite(s): Wilderling or Blessed by the Wild, must not have Bond of Fauna

Benefit(s): You gain visibly plant-like features, with possibilities ranging from the hair of vines and leaves to skin that looks like bark. You gain the following spell-like abilities, each usable once per day with a caster level equal to your character level:

Detect plants: as detect animals or plants, but can only be used on plants.
Speak with Plants

Every time you select a feat that requires Bond of Flora, your plant-like features become more pronounced.

Call of the Wild, Book 1 – The Druid. © 2017 d20pfsrd.com Publishing; Author: Kalen Tessmann
